body.x: Chois Technology(CEO, Choi Soon-pil, www.choistec.com) introduced 'XPS300BT', remote controller with Bluetooth 4.0 Low Energy(BLE) at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
XPS300BT is a mobile presenter for iPhone and Galaxy on Bluetooth 4.0 BLE base. It can transform smartphone into the wireless presenter by using X-Pointer Smart application.

X-Pointer Pulse Stylus: XPS-300 is made with aluminum which is available as stylus pen and also as a handy charger with using USB cable. It has lamp function that checks laser operation status for user security. Its special app is necessary to operates the device.

X-Pointer Smart: XPS-200BT is world first smart remote controller linked to PC, which goes without any additional software. The device is compatible with smart phones housing Bluetooth 4.0 Low Energy to control TV. It even expands smart devices into wireless keyboard, mouse, touchpad.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
